transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?

Thank you for confirming. I’m calling regarding your Mumbai Bank credit card. Our records show that the minimum amount due of Rs 4,820 was payable by 2026-10-15, and it has not yet been received. 

May I know if you are able to make this payment soon? If you have already paid, please let me know the date and mode of payment.
I already paid that amount two days ago through UPI. So I’m not sure why you’re calling about this.
